_comment: Site changelog (changelog.html). Newest first. Features and new pages = entries with 1-3 short items (optional link, "shots": [...] — 2+ = carousel). Small changes = {"minor": true, date, category, title, optional link}: listed under the day, folded under a toggle when there are more than 3. Categories: Patch Reader, Materials, Hero Lab, Dynamics, Site. Add an entry in the same commit as the change. "fix": true = a correction of something that was wrong (shown with a pixel beetle).

entries.title: SWAP tag and a lit talent tree
items: Replaced talents get their own teal SWAP tag (455 rows); REWORK now means a real rework
The talent tree lights the changed twigs in gold, left or right on levels 10–25, as in the game
